team.title: Your bazaar crew
team.sub: Four AI agents, each with one job. Code computes the numbers; the AI only reads your request and writes the explanation.
team.ctaBody: Type or say your shopping list — four agents build a plan in a minute.

bm.title: How Bozor-Analitika earns
bm.sub: Free for buyers. Sellers, banks and data customers pay. Prices are planned; no revenue yet.
bm.s1p: ~{{pct}}% of each order that came through the platform. Sellers pay only when they sell.
bm.s2p: ~${{usd}} per approved loan. Xazinachi opa already spots who needs one; the buyer’s rate stays the same.
bm.s3p: ~${{usd}}/month for banks, wholesalers and analysts: live offers, trends, regional breakdowns.
bm.s4p: ~${{usd}}/month for multi-branch businesses: joint buying, reports, price alerts.
bm.cPlan: One purchase plan (2 AI calls, Gemini Flash, paid tier)
bm.cRev: Revenue: ~{{mln}} mln so‘m bought a month × {{pct}}% fee
bm.free: Within the Gemini free tier the AI cost is $0.
bm.note: Estimate, $1 ≈ 12,000 so‘m. Gemini Flash price roughly $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens; one plan ≈ 4,000 input + 700 output tokens. Today everything runs on free tiers; figures are rounded.
